name: Hindmata Cinema
alternateRoute: Take Dr. B.A. Road Flyover (Hindmata Flyover) to bypass the ground level roadway.
notes: Saucer-shaped chronic depression point; water accumulates rapidly during heavy downpours.

name: Milan Subway
alternateRoute: Use Milan Rail Overbridge (Milan Flyover) to cross between SV Road and Western Express Highway.
notes: Underpass prone to rapid inundation; closed early by traffic police when rainfall exceeds 25 mm/hr.

name: Andheri Subway
alternateRoute: Divert via Gokhale Bridge or Balasaheb Thackeray Flyover (Jogeshwari).
notes: Critical arterial underpass that collects storm runoff from surrounding elevated areas; high risk of vehicle stalling.

name: Sion Circle
alternateRoute: Use the elevated Sion Flyover along Eastern Express Highway; avoid ground rotary.
notes: Major central junction prone to ponding that impedes arterial bus traffic towards Thane and South Mumbai.

name: King's Circle (Maheshwari Udyan)
alternateRoute: Use King's Circle Flyover or re-route through R.A. Kidwai Road.
notes: Extremely low elevation near railway tracks; floods severely when rainfall coincides with high tide.

name: Dadar TT Circle
alternateRoute: Use Tilak Bridge or Senapati Bapat Marg elevated stretches.
notes: High traffic density junction where localized water accumulation leads to severe vehicular bottlenecks.

name: Kurla Kamani / LBS Marg
alternateRoute: Use Santacruz-Chembur Link Road (SCLR) or the BKC connector elevated route.
notes: Adjacent to the Mithi River catchment; severe overflow risk during combined heavy rainfall and high tide.

name: Chembur (Postal Colony / Shell Colony)
alternateRoute: Divert via Eastern Freeway or Ghatkopar-Mankhurd Link Road.
notes: Internal collector roads suffer from slow gravity drainage, causing 1-2 feet standing water.

name: Gandhi Market
alternateRoute: Take Dr. B.A. Road Flyover towards Eastern Express Highway; do not enter service lanes.
notes: Frequent waterlogging location where municipal dewatering pumps run continuously during monsoons.

name: Parel TT / Lower Parel Junction
alternateRoute: Take Senapati Bapat Marg elevated road or Lower Parel Flyover.
notes: Low-lying bowl in the former mill district; access roads to suburban stations get waterlogged.

name: Mahim Causeway
alternateRoute: Use Bandra-Worli Sea Link (BWSL) or Western Express Highway bridge.
notes: Tidal backflow at the Mithi River mouth can cause water accumulation and heavy traffic snarls during stormy tides.

name: Malad Subway
alternateRoute: Use Malad Flyover or Mith Chowki Link Road.
notes: Deep underpass connecting east and west suburbs; barricaded immediately when water crosses 1 foot.

name: Dahisar Subway
alternateRoute: Use Western Express Highway flyover or Anand Nagar flyover.
notes: Northernmost suburban underpass; drainage canal overflow can temporarily block traffic.

name: Khar Subway
alternateRoute: Use SV Road / Linking Road or Bandra ROB (Hill Road/Turner Road bridge).
notes: Sub-surface railway underpass prone to flash water logging; high disruption for auto-rickshaws and two-wheelers.

name: Worli Naka
alternateRoute: Take Dr. Annie Besant Road or Senapati Bapat Marg via Nehru Centre flyover.
notes: Near coastal drainage outfalls; water ponding occurs when high tide gates are closed during heavy rain.
